name: Bhutte Ka Kees
ingredients: 2 cups fresh sweet corn kernels, grated
instructions: 1. Grate the fresh corn kernels using a medium-sized grater to create a coarse paste.
2. Heat ghee in a heavy-bottomed pan and add mustard seeds, cumin seeds, and asafoetida.
3. Once the seeds crackle, add chopped green chilies and grated ginger, sautéing for a minute.
4. Add the grated corn, turmeric, red chili powder, coriander powder, and salt. Cook on medium heat for 5-7 minutes.
5. Pour in the milk, cover the pan, and let it simmer on low heat until the corn is tender and the mixture turns creamy.
6. Add sugar if desired, then stir in lemon juice.
7. Garnish generously with grated coconut and fresh coriander before serving hot.
description: Bhutte Ka Kees is a signature street food specialty from Indore, Madhya Pradesh. It is a comforting, nutritious, and mildly spiced dish made from grated fresh corn, traditionally enjoyed as a teatime snack during the monsoon season.
